title: The Sun in Aries
excerpt: The Sun governs the core of you — the self God addresses by name. In Aries it works with a first-thing directness.
body:
The Sun governs the core of you — the self God addresses by name. It is not a verdict on your life; it is a description of a current you have always felt and perhaps never had words for.

In Aries, that current runs with a first-thing directness — you move before you are certain, and you are usually right to. You will recognise it immediately or resist it for a decade — both reactions are common, and both are information.

The temptation with a placement like this is to treat it as a limit. It is closer to a language. You are not obliged to speak it well on the first try. “The Lord is my light and my salvation” (Psalm 27:1)

Sit with one question this week: where has the Sun in Aries served you, and where have you been apologising for it? The stars incline; they do not compel. What inclines you here was given, not imposed.

title: The Sun in Aries, the First House
excerpt: The Sun in Aries falling in the First House — your body and your beginnings — how you arrive.
body:
The Sun in Aries already tells you how: with a first-thing directness — you move before you are certain, and you are usually right to. the First House tells you where — your body and your beginnings — how you arrive.

This is the placement people describe as “the thing that keeps coming up.” It is not a curse and it is not a coincidence. It is simply the room of your life where this particular current runs closest to the surface, and therefore where it is easiest to notice and to steward.

Pray specifically here. Vague prayer over “everything” exhausts the one praying; the houses exist so you can name the room. “The Lord is my light and my salvation” (Psalm 27:1)

One practice: for the next month, when something in your body and your beginnings unsettles you, ask whether it is the Sun in Aries speaking rather than a failure of faith. Usually it is the former, and the relief of knowing that is itself a kind of grace.

One practice: for the next month, when something in your inner room unsettles you, ask whether it is the Moon in Pisces speaking rather than a failure of faith. Usually it is the former, and the relief of knowing that is itself a kind of grace.

body:
Saturn in Cancer already tells you how: protectively — you feel the room before you enter it, and you guard what is soft. the Tenth House tells you where — your calling and your standing in the world.

This is the placement people describe as “the thing that keeps coming up.” It is not a curse and it is not a coincidence. It is simply the room of your life where this particular current runs closest to the surface, and therefore where it is easiest to notice and to steward.

Pray specifically here. Vague prayer over “everything” exhausts the one praying; the houses exist so you can name the room. “The Lord is not slack concerning his promise” (2 Peter 3:9)

One practice: for the next month, when something in your calling and your standing in the world unsettles you, ask whether it is Saturn in Cancer speaking rather than a failure of faith. Usually it is the former, and the relief of knowing that is itself a kind of grace.

body:
Pluto in Aquarius already tells you how: at a slight angle to everyone else — you see the thing the group has agreed not to say. the Eleventh House tells you where — your friendships and the community you are building.

This is the placement people describe as “the thing that keeps coming up.” It is not a curse and it is not a coincidence. It is simply the room of your life where this particular current runs closest to the surface, and therefore where it is easiest to notice and to steward.

Pray specifically here. Vague prayer over “everything” exhausts the one praying; the houses exist so you can name the room. “Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die” (John 12:24)

One practice: for the next month, when something in your friendships and the community you are building unsettles you, ask whether it is Pluto in Aquarius speaking rather than a failure of faith. Usually it is the former, and the relief of knowing that is itself a kind of grace.
